flows:
Navigate to http://127.0.0.1:8001/login then log in with email {{global.account1_email}} and password {{secrets.user.account1_password}}.
Open the page for booking a new appointment.
Select the patient named Aisha, set the date to 2025-03-03 and the time to 10:00, then click the button to book or save.
Store what the page shows after that as 'what_happened'.
Verify that the app shows an error saying the date is in the past and the appointment was not saved.
